answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying every identity to a locked collateral bond: to run k fake agents an attacker must post k independent bonds, so the cost grows linearly with the clone count. Caught fraud slashes the bond, making the attempt a net loss. One verified human, one stake rules out minting a whole meadow of agents from a stolen ember of identity; any try to ripple forged attestations through the network forfeits every deposit.
